title: Kwitanga ku bushake
intro: Mu gihe cy'ibigeragezo by'Imana, umuntu yahamagariwe gukora igikorwa cy'ikirenga cyo kuganduka. Yakuriye mu gihugu cy'ubutayu, uyu muntu yakuze agaragaza ukwizera n'ukwihangana. Iyo iyerekwa ryasabaga igitambo, ntibatezukaga. Inkuru yabo ni inkingi y'ishingiro ry'ubwitange.
clues: Nari igisubizo cy'isengesho ry'umuhanuzi ukomeye ryari ritegerejwe igihe kirekire.
Jye na mama twasigaye mu kibaya cyari kidatuwe dufite gusa ibiryo by'amatike n'amazi.
Nakuze mba umuhanuzi uzwiho kuba umunyakuri no kwihangana.
Nafashije data kuzamura urufatiro rw'inzu yera yeguriwe Imana.
Ubwo data yambwiraga inzozi zo kuntambira igitambo, naramushubije nti 'Kora uko wategetswe.'
Imana yubashye ukwishyira mu mwanya wanjye yohereza imfizi y'intama iturutse mu ijuru kugira ngo incungure.

options: Kwemera ku bushake kugira ngo umuntu yitange
trial.answer: Kwemera ku bushake kugira ngo umuntu yitange

arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast." (37:102)
